mechanism_narrative: The continued week-by-week rise in WORKPLACES mobility signals a gradual return of in-person commuting that increases weekday foot traffic and nearby purchases, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the prior 4-week mean after four more weeks despite WORKPLACES continuing to improve.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility falls further from its already elevated level, more people spend time outside the home and allocate trips to shops and restaurants, lifting RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL drops by at least 1 point week-on-week from an already positive level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after a further RESIDENTIAL decline.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in TRANSIT stations alongside WORKPLACES indicates commuting normalization; that combined movement expands access to commercial districts and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move above its recent 4-week average after simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility rises sharply while TRANSIT remains deeply depressed, leisure trips substitute toward outdoor time instead of shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 points in a week while TRANSIT remains below -70
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite a PARKS surge occurring while TRANSIT stays below -70.

mechanism_narrative: A broad improvement in TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and GROCERY_PHARM indicates looser local conditions and more errand chaining, which should lift retail visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days when transit, work, and grocery mobility all trend upward together.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS during late-summer conditions diverts discretionary time away from indoor retail and recreation, so RETAIL_REC falls relative to the preceding month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though PARKS remains on an upward path.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls another few points after being already very low, access friction to shopping districts worsens and suppresses retail activity with a one-week lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -75 after already being below -72
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -75.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES signals more routine trip chaining, which spills over into discretionary shopping and raises RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days despite both GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES improving together.
